title: Nutty Thai Chicken Curry
description: A peppery and creamy Thai dish featuring dark brown sugar, perfect for a post-workout meal, made in a ceramic tagine with a pasta water emulsion.
instructions: Heat the ceramic tagine over medium heat and add the peanut butter to melt.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken to the tagine and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the dark brown sugar, fish sauce, and lime juice to the tagine and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and pasta water, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season the curry with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish the curry with chopped peanuts and serve hot.
Serve the curry over rice or noodles, if desired.
